item.content:encoded:
WHAT ARE YOU FIGHTING FOR?

Join Nashville’s Best Boxing Gym and Find Something Worth Fighting For.

GET STARTED 0Trainees0Experts0Years0Countries

WE ARE ALL FIGHTERS: WHAT ARE YOU FIGHTING FOR?

Everyone’s fighting for something.

For some, it’s fitness. For others, it’s focus, confidence, or just a little peace of mind. Whatever your fight looks like, you’ll find your place here.

At Fighters Boxing Gym, we’ve built more than a gym we’ve built a community. A place where people push limits, support each other, and keep showing up no matter what life throws their way. Whether you’re stepping into the ring for the first time or training for your next bout, you’ll get real coaching, real results, and people who’ve got your back.

No egos. No gimmicks. Just hard work, respect, and progress.

You’ll leave every class stronger not just in body, but in mindset. When you train here, you learn more than combinations and footwork. You learn to stay calm under pressure, to show up when it’s hard, and to keep fighting in and out of the ring.

GET STARTED

NASHVILLE BOXING AT ITS BEST

Welcome to Fighters Boxing Gym, Nashville’s best boxing facility.

We’re not just another fitness club with a few heavy bags in the corner — this is a real boxing gym built for real boxers.

Our programs are designed for all levels — from total beginners to seasoned fighters — with options for group classes, youth classes, private sessions, open gym, and sparring. We’ve created an environment where everyone’s welcome to learn the classic art of boxing, get fit, and have fun doing it.

We believe boxing isn’t just a workout. It’s therapy, it’s discipline, it’s empowerment. It teaches you how to breathe under pressure, stay sharp when tired, and fight back when life hits hard. That’s why we’ve dropped every barrier to entry — no experience needed, no ego allowed. Just show up, put in the work, and discover what you’re capable of.

So, what are you fighting for?

Come find out inside Nashville’s best boxing gym — Fighters Boxing Gym — where every round counts and everyone has a reason to fight.

GET STARTED Don't miss

Next fight, new triumph

that teaches the fundamentals stance, footwork, defense, and proper punching mechanics all in a safe, high-energy environment.

You’ll learn how to move like a boxer, hit the bag with purpose, and build real conditioning without ever taking a punch. Every round is designed to challenge you, build confidence, and help you see progress fast.

No experience needed. Just bring your gloves, your determined attitude, and we’ll handle the rest.

YOUTH BOXING CLASSES

Our Youth Boxing Program teaches kids more than just how to throw punches it builds confidence, discipline, and focus.

This class introduces proper boxing fundamentals in a fun, structured, and non-contact environment. Kids learn stance, movement, blocking, coordination, and technique while developing the respect and work ethic that only come from real training.

Led by experienced coaches who know how to challenge and motivate, every session helps kids grow stronger inside and out. Whether your child’s goal is fitness, confidence, or competition down the road, this is where it all starts.

COMPETITION TEAM TRAINING

This is where the work gets put to the test. Our Competition Team Training program is built for dedicated athletes ready to level up whether you’re chasing your first amateur fight or already grinding toward the pros.

This advanced class combines technical refinement, ring strategy, sparring, and fight conditioning under the guidance of experienced coaches who’ve been there and done it. Every round is focused, every drill has a purpose, and every session moves you closer to being fight-ready.

You’ll train alongside hungry amateurs and seasoned pros who bring out your best every day. It’s intense. It’s disciplined. And it’s designed for those serious about stepping between the ropes and competing at their highest level.

If you’re ready to see what you’re made of this is the place to prove it.

item.title: Our Gyms – Fighters Nashville
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
Nashville's Premier Combat Sports Experience

TWO LEGENDS.
ONE TEAM.

Fighters Boxing Gym and Nashville MMA Training Camp — two world-class facilities united by a shared obsession with excellence. Whatever your goal, you'll find the coaching, equipment, and community to reach it.

Fighters Boxing Gym Nashville MMA Camp Home›Our Gyms 20+Years of
Championship
Training

Who We Are

TWO NASHVILLE
POWERHOUSES.
ONE CHAMPIONSHIP
TEAM.

For over two decades, Nashville MMA Training Camp and Fighters Boxing Gym have set the standard for combat sports and fitness in Tennessee. Each gym stands strong on its own — world-class training, expert coaches, and championship results.

Together, they create something even bigger: a complete training experience built for every kind of fighter. Whether your goal is to step into the ring, master martial arts, or simply get in the best shape of your life, you'll find the environment, equipment, and coaching you need inside our doors.

See the Championship Package Fighters Boxing Gym

Gym One

FIGHTERS
BOXING
GYM

The Heart of Nashville's Boxing Scene

The heart of Nashville's boxing scene. Fighters Boxing Gym delivers top-tier instruction for all skill levels — from complete beginners learning the basics to professionals preparing for their next bout.

Train under USA Certified coaches with real fight experience and a genuine passion for developing every athlete who walks through the door. Step into a space built for real boxing: professional rings, heavy bags, and a community that pushes you to perform.

  • Beginner, intermediate, and competition-level classes
  • Professional boxing rings & full bag setup
  • USA Boxing Certified & Olympic-development coaches
  • Youth program for ages 7–17
  • Open gym, group classes & private sessions available
  • Located at 405 42nd Ave N, Nashville, TN 37209
View Boxing Classes

Gym Two

NASHVILLE
MMA
TRAINING CAMP

Elite Martial Arts · Southeast's Best

Home to some of the best martial artists in the Southeast, Nashville MMA Training Camp offers elite-level instruction across Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Kickboxing, Muay Thai, Wrestling, MMA, and Fitness.

With a reputation built over 20+ years, it's where athletes of all levels come to train smart, train hard, and train like champions. World-class coaches and a top-tier facility make it one of the most complete training environments in the country.

  • Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Muay Thai, Kickboxing & Wrestling
  • MMA cage, grappling mats & full striking setup
  • State-of-the-art Recovery Room on site
  • Pro fighters & everyday warriors both welcome
  • 20+ years building Southeast champions
  • Accessible via the Championship Package
Visit Nashville MMA Nashville MMA Camp 20+Years in Nashville 2World-Class Gyms 500+Active Members 6+Disciplines Taught USACertified Coaches 🏆

The Complete Experience

THE CHAMPIONSHIP PACKAGE

Can't choose just one? You don't have to. The Championship Package grants you full, unlimited access to both Fighters Boxing Gym and Nashville MMA Training Camp — everything under one membership.

🥊Professional Boxing Rings & MMA CagesTrain on competition-grade equipment at both facilities 🥋Full Grappling Mat AccessBJJ, wrestling, and Muay Thai floor space at Nashville MMA 💪Complete Fitness GymWeights, cardio, functional training, and endless bag rows 🔋State-of-the-Art Recovery RoomExclusive access at Nashville MMA — train hard, recover harder 📅All Classes at Both GymsBoxing, BJJ, Muay Thai, Kickboxing, Wrestling, MMA & Fitness Get Championship Package Info

Expert Instruction

MEET THE COACHES

Our coaches aren't just instructors — they're fighters, mentors, and lifelong students of the sport who've dedicated their careers to your development.

COACH MARCUS Head Coach · Fighters Boxing Gym

25+ years in competitive boxing. USA Boxing certified with Olympic-development credentials. Marcus built Fighters Nashville from the ground up and coaches every level from beginner to competitor.

COACH DIANA Youth & Beginner Specialist

Specializes in turning complete beginners and young athletes into confident, disciplined fighters. Her structured approach has helped hundreds find their footing and fall in love with boxing.

COACH RAY Competition Team · Fighters Boxing Gym

Decorated amateur boxer and multiple regional title holder. Ray leads the competition team with a relentless focus on technical development, fight IQ, and producing Southeast champions.

Meet All Coaches

Real Members · Real Results

WHAT NASHVILLE IS SAYING

★★★★★

"Fighters Nashville is the real deal. I've trained at gyms across the country and the coaching here is genuinely Olympic-level. The community pulls you in and keeps you coming back every single week."

M Marcus W.Competition Team · 2 years ★★★★★

"I started with zero experience and zero confidence. After three months at Fighters Boxing Gym I've lost weight, gained real strength, and I actually look forward to working out. It changed everything."

S Sarah M.Beginner Boxing · Nashville, TN ★★★★★

"The Championship Package is incredible value. Having access to both the boxing gym and Nashville MMA means I can cross-train in a way I never could before. Best fitness decision I've ever made."

J Jordan K.Championship Package · 1 year

YOUR FIRST CLASS
IS ON US.

No experience needed. No pressure. Just show up and see what you're capable of inside Nashville's best boxing gym.

Book Your Free Trial Class View All Classes FIGHTERS NASHVILLE

Nashville's premier boxing and combat sports facility. Fighters Boxing Gym + Nashville MMA Training Camp. Est. 2004.

📷📞✉

  • Nashville MMA Camp
  • Championship Package
  • Boxing Classes

Quick Links

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
Effective Date: 4/2/2026
At Fighters Boxing Gym and Nashville MMA Training Camp (“we,” “our,” or “us”), your privacy matters. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our website or engage with our services.
1. Information We Collect
We may collect the following types of information:
Personal Information
  • Name
  • Email address

2. How We Use Your Information
We use your information to:
  • Provide and manage memberships and services
  • Respond to inquiries and customer support requests
  • Send updates, promotions, or important notifications
  • Improve our website and user experience
3. Sharing Your Information
We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may share information only with:
  • Trusted service providers (for payment processing, email systems, etc.)
  • Legal authorities if required by law
4. Cookies & Tracking
Our website may use cookies to:
  • Enhance user experience
  • Analyze website traffic
  • Improve performance
You can disable cookies through your browser settings.
5. Data Security
We take reasonable steps to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
6. Your Rights
You have the right to:
  • Access your personal data
  • Request corrections
  • Request deletion of your data
To exercise these rights, contact us at: support@fightersnashville.com
7. Third-Party Links
Our website may contain links to external sites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices.
8. Updates to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.
9. Contact Us
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at: support@fightersnashville.com

item.title: Home
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
WHAT ARE YOU FIGHTING FOR?

Join Nashville’s Best Boxing Gym and Find Something Worth Fighting For.

GET STARTED

WE ARE ALL FIGHTERS: WHAT ARE YOU FIGHTING FOR?

Everyone’s fighting for something.

For some, it’s fitness. For others, it’s focus, confidence, or just a little peace of mind. Whatever your fight looks like, you’ll find your place here.

At Fighters Boxing Gym, we’ve built more than a gym we’ve built a community. A place where people push limits, support each other, and keep showing up no matter what life throws their way. Whether you’re stepping into the ring for the first time or training for your next bout, you’ll get real coaching, real results, and people who’ve got your back.

No egos. No gimmicks. Just hard work, respect, and progress.

You’ll leave every class stronger not just in body, but in mindset. When you train here, you learn more than combinations and footwork. You learn to stay calm under pressure, to show up when it’s hard, and to keep fighting in and out of the ring.

GET STARTED

NASHVILLE BOXING AT ITS BEST

Welcome to Fighters Boxing Gym, Nashville’s best boxing facility.

We’re not just another fitness club with a few heavy bags in the corner — this is a real boxing gym built for real boxers.

Our programs are designed for all levels — from total beginners to seasoned fighters — with options for group classes, youth classes, private sessions, open gym, and sparring. We’ve created an environment where everyone’s welcome to learn the classic art of boxing, get fit, and have fun doing it.

We believe boxing isn’t just a workout. It’s therapy, it’s discipline, it’s empowerment. It teaches you how to breathe under pressure, stay sharp when tired, and fight back when life hits hard. That’s why we’ve dropped every barrier to entry — no experience needed, no ego allowed. Just show up, put in the work, and discover what you’re capable of.

So, what are you fighting for?

Come find out inside Nashville’s best boxing gym — Fighters Boxing Gym — where every round counts and everyone has a reason to fight.

GET STARTED

support@fightersnashville.com

Train Like a Pro

The Benefits of Open Gym at Nashville’s Best Boxing Gym

At Fighters Boxing Gym in Nashville, our open gym access gives you the freedom to train like a pro at your own pace. Whether you’re working on your footwork, perfecting your punches, or building endurance, our gym offers the equipment and space you need to sharpen your skills. It’s a true boxing gym—designed for those serious about the sport.

Unlike typical fitness boxing gyms, our open gym is about real training. You’ll be able to push yourself, focus on technique, and elevate your game without distractions. Whether you’re preparing for a fight or just aiming to improve, the open gym at Fighters Boxing Gym is where real progress happens.

At Fighters Boxing Gym in Nashville, our open gym access gives you the freedom to train like a pro at your own pace. Whether you’re working on your footwork, perfecting your punches, or building endurance, our gym offers the equipment and space you need to sharpen your skills. It’s a true boxing gym—designed for those serious about the sport.

Unlike typical fitness boxing gyms, our open gym is about real training. You’ll be able to push yourself, focus on technique, and elevate your game without distractions. Whether you’re preparing for a fight or just aiming to improve, the open gym at Fighters Boxing Gym is where real progress happens.

At Fighters Boxing Gym in Nashville, our open gym access gives you the freedom to train like a pro at your own pace. Whether you’re working on your footwork, perfecting your punches, or building endurance, our gym offers the equipment and space you need to sharpen your skills. It’s a true boxing gym—designed for those serious about the sport.

Unlike typical fitness boxing gyms, our open gym is about real training. You’ll be able to push yourself, focus on technique, and elevate your game without distractions. Whether you’re preparing for a fight or just aiming to improve, the open gym at Fighters Boxing Gym is where real progress happens.

item.title: Boxing Classes
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
New to boxing?

Perfect!

that teaches the fundamentals stance, footwork, defense, and proper punching mechanics all in a safe, high-energy environment.

You’ll learn how to move like a boxer, hit the bag with purpose, and build real conditioning without ever taking a punch. Every round is designed to challenge you, build confidence, and help you see progress fast.

No experience needed. Just bring your gloves, your determined attitude, and we’ll handle the rest.

YOUTH BOXING CLASSES

Our Youth Boxing Program teaches kids more than just how to throw punches it builds confidence, discipline, and focus.

This class introduces proper boxing fundamentals in a fun, structured, and non-contact environment. Kids learn stance, movement, blocking, coordination, and technique while developing the respect and work ethic that only come from real training.

Led by experienced coaches who know how to challenge and motivate, every session helps kids grow stronger inside and out. Whether your child’s goal is fitness, confidence, or competition down the road, this is where it all starts.

COMPETITION TEAM TRAINING

This is where the work gets put to the test. Our Competition Team Training program is built for dedicated athletes ready to level up whether you’re chasing your first amateur fight or already grinding toward the pros.

This advanced class combines technical refinement, ring strategy, sparring, and fight conditioning under the guidance of experienced coaches who’ve been there and done it. Every round is focused, every drill has a purpose, and every session moves you closer to being fight-ready.

You’ll train alongside hungry amateurs and seasoned pros who bring out your best every day. It’s intense. It’s disciplined. And it’s designed for those serious about stepping between the ropes and competing at their highest level.

If you’re ready to see what you’re made of this is the place to prove it.

CrossFit is lifestyle.

It fosters strength

of mind and body!

Learn the Foundations of Real Boxing

Our Beginners Boxing Class is where your journey starts. This is a non-contact, technique-driven program built for anyone looking to learn the art of boxing the right way. You’ll master the essentials — stance, footwork, defense, and proper punching mechanics — under the guidance of USA Certified coaches who teach with patience, precision, and passion. Every session builds your coordination, timing, and conditioning while keeping the atmosphere fun, challenging, and safe.

Read More

Train Like a Fighter, Without Taking a Punch

You don’t need to be in fighting shape to start — you just need the will to show up. Our coaches break down every movement step-by-step so you can train confidently, improve your fitness, and build a fighter’s mindset. Expect sweat, progress, and motivation from the moment you step on the floor.

A Gym Built for Everyone

We built Fighters Boxing Gym for people of all experience levels from those stepping into the gym for the first time to those who just want to stay sharp. You’ll leave every class stronger, more confident, and ready to take on the next challenge inside and outside the ring. CrossFit programs

item.title: Our Gyms
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
Two Nashville Powerhouses. One Championship Team.

For over two decades, Nashville MMA Training Camp and Fighters Boxing Gym have set the standard for combat sports and fitness in Tennessee. Each gym stands strong on its own world-class training, expert coaches, and championship results but together, they create something even bigger: a complete training experience built for every kind of fighter.

Whether your goal is to step into the ring, master martial arts, or simply get in the best shape of your life, you’ll find the environment, equipment, and coaching you need inside our doors.

get more information

FIGHTERS BOXING GYM

The heart of Nashville’s boxing scene. Fighters Boxing Gym delivers top-tier instruction in boxing for all skill levels — from beginners learning the basics to professionals preparing for competition. You’ll train under USA Certified coaches with real fight experience and a passion for helping you grow stronger, sharper, and more confident.
Step into a space built for real boxing: bags, rings, and a community that pushes you to perform.

get more information

Layouts: Popup

Dr. Christy Halbert

Founder, Director

Kayla Trotter

Boxer

Evan Carr

Fighter

NASHVILLE MMA TRAINING CAMP

Home to some of the best martial artists in the Southeast, Nashville MMA Training Camp offers elite-level instruction in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Kickboxing, Muay Thai, Wrestling, MMA, and Fitness. With a reputation built over 20+ years, it’s where athletes of all levels come to train smart, train hard, and train like champions.

From professional fighters to everyday warriors, Nashville MMA’s world-class coaching staff and top-tier facility make it one of the most complete training environments in the country.

get more information Welcome to our club

Meet the Coaches

Our Team

THE CHAMPIONSHIP PACKAGE

Can’t pick just one? You don’t have to.
Our Championship Package gives you full access to both gyms and all of their amenities:

  • Professional boxing rings, MMA cages, and grappling mats
  • Full fitness gym with weights, cardio, and functional training equipment
  • Endless rows of heavy bags and striking tools
  • Access to the state-of-the-art Recovery Room at Nashville MMA

Train like a fighter, recover like a pro, and experience the best that Nashville combat sports has to offer — all under one membership.

get more information

Layouts: Popup

ONE COMMUNITY. TWO LEGENDS.

For over 20 years, both gyms have built reputations for excellence, toughness, and integrity. Now, they’re united by a shared mission — to help every athlete, from first-timers to pros, reach their potential.

Whether you start at Fighters Boxing Gym, dive into training at Nashville MMA, or join the Championship Package, you’re stepping into a system that’s produced champions, built confidence, and changed lives.

get more information Testimonials

Our happy clients

Building Confidence, Character, and Skill

Our Youth Boxing Program is more than just a workout — it’s a foundation for life. Designed for ages 8 and up, this non-contact class introduces kids to proper stance, movement, defense, and striking fundamentals. Led by USA Certified coaches, our program builds coordination, focus, and discipline in a structured, high-energy environment that kids actually enjoy.

Read More

Real Coaching, Real Mentorship

Our coaching staff brings top-tier boxing knowledge and years of experience training athletes at every level. We focus on technique and development, but also on the values that make great boxers respect, patience, perseverance, and confidence. Every class balances fun learning, ensuring your child stays motivated, and growing stronger kids both mentally and physically.

A Safe and Supportive Community

At Fighters Boxing Gym, every young athlete is part of the team. There’s no pressure to compete just a supportive environment where kids can build skills, stay active, and find pride in their progress. Whether they’re training for fun, fitness, or a future in the sport, we’ll help them grow into their best selves one round at a time. CrossFit programs

CrossFit is lifestyle.

It fosters strength

of mind and body!

Train Like a Fighter, Compete Like a Champion

Our Competition Team Training is the real deal — a program designed for serious athletes who want to test their limits. Led by USA Certified coaches with years of amateur and professional fight experience. This advanced class focuses on sparring, conditioning, technical refinement, and ring IQ. You’ll train alongside active competitors who push you to bring your best every round.

Read More

Built for Competitors and the Committed

While many members of our competition team actively fight in sanctioned bouts, not everyone chooses to compete — and that’s perfectly fine. Plenty of athletes train with the team for the challenge, discipline, and skill development that comes with high-level boxing. The atmosphere is focused, respectful, and intense exactly what you’d expect from a real fight gym.

Entry Requirements

Because this program is built for experienced boxers, we don’t allow first-time visitors to jump straight into the competition class unless they know or have been invited by one of our coaches. If you’re new, we recommend taking a Boxing Basics Class first to be evaluated, stopping by for a gym tour, or simply coming in to meet the coaching staff. Once you’re ready, we’ll help you earn your spot and start training with Nashville’s best. CrossFit programs

item.title: What to Expect
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
Step Into the Ring Your First Workout Starts Here

Your first day at Fighters Boxing Gym is where it all begins. You don’t need experience — just a good attitude, a little time, and the willingness to work. Here’s what to expect when you walk through our doors.

ARRIVE EARLY & GET SET UP

Show up 20 minutes before class so we can take care of the important stuff — sign your waiver, get you checked in, and give you a quick gym tour. We’ll show you the layout, explain how classes work, and introduce you to your coach. This is your time to get comfortable, ask questions, and get your mind right before class starts.
Our staff will make sure you’re ready to go and that you feel like part of the team from day one.

GEAR UP & LEARN THE BASICS

If you have your own gloves and wraps, bring them! If not, no problem — we’ve got loaner equipment
. Your coach will walk you through stance, movement, and the basic punches so you can hit the ground running (and the bag hard).
Every class is led by USA Certified coaches who know how to teach safely, motivate effectively, and make sure everyone from beginners to veterans gets real work in.

IT’S GO TIME

Once the music’s on and the gloves are up, it’s all business. You’ll train like a fighter learning real technique, building endurance, and discovering what you’re made of. Each class brings a mix of skill work, bag rounds, conditioning, and energy that keeps you coming back.
No two sessions are the same, but the goal never changes: leave stronger, sharper, and more confident than when you walked in.

YOU’RE PART OF THE TEAM NOW

We’re not just another gym we’re a community of people who show up, put in the work, and push each other to get better. Whether you’re here to get fit, learn the sport, or chase competition, we’re in your corner every step of the way.
You’ll sweat. You’ll laugh. You’ll grow.
And before long, you’ll realize you’re a fighter too.

Effective Date: 4/2/2026

Welcome to Fighters Boxing Gym and Nashville MMA Training Camp. By using our website and services, you agree to the following terms.

1. Use of Website

By accessing this website, you agree to:

  • Use it only for lawful purposes
  • Not misuse or attempt to disrupt the website
  • Provide accurate information when required
2. Membership & Services
  • Memberships, classes, and services are subject to availability
  • We reserve the right to modify schedules, pricing, or offerings at any time
  • Participation in training is at your own risk
3. Health & Responsibility

By participating in any training:

  • You confirm you are physically able to participate
  • You understand the risks involved in combat sports and fitness training
  • You agree that Fighters Boxing Gym and Nashville MMA Training Camp are not liable for injuries
4. Payments & Refunds
  • All payments must be made as agreed at the time of purchase
  • Refund policies (if applicable) will be communicated separately
  • Late or failed payments may result in suspension of services
5. Intellectual Property

All content on this website (text, images, branding) is owned by us and may not be copied, reproduced, or distributed without permission.

6. Limitation of Liability

We are not responsible for:

  • Injuries sustained during training
  • Loss of personal belongings
  • Website downtime or technical issues
7. Termination

We reserve the right to:

  • Suspend or terminate access to our services for violations of these terms
  • Refuse service at our discretion
8. Changes to Terms

We may update these Terms & Conditions at any time. Continued use of the website means you accept the updated terms.

9. Contact Information

For any questions regarding these terms, please contact:
support@fightersnashville.com

item.title: 10 Ways to Protect Yourself when Boxing
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
1. Keep your eyes on target. If you have a blink reflex, train it away as soon as possible. If your eyes are closed, you can’t see punches coming. Stay focused on your opponent, and be aware of where their fists are at all times.
  2. Keep your hands up. Dropping your hands is a sign you’re tired or inexperienced. Keep your hands up to protect your head.
  3. Warm up. Warming up is critical for protecting against injury. Increasing body temperature increases blood flow, preps muscles and joints, and decreases muscle and join stiffness.
  4. Take fitness seriously. When you start sparring and competing, make sure you’ve got the wind to get you across all three rounds. If you’re tired, you’ll move more slowly, your reaction time is slower, and boxing fails to be fun.
  5. Keep breathing. Oxygen supplies the muscles of the body, so take intentional breaths, which will also help keep you calm and relaxed in the ring.
  6. Respect sparring partners. Don’t jump in over your head when it comes to sparring partners. Take it slowly. Work on skills. If you turn it up, expect your sparring partner will, also.
  7. Wear safety equipment. Wear the necessary protective gear, such as mouthguard, hand wraps, training gloves, etc. And wrap your hands properly.
  8. Take time off for injuries. Show respect for yourself by taking a little break when you feel like an injury may have occurred.
  9. Make smart training decisions. Don’t overtrain. Your body needs adequate rest to recover and avoid over-use injuries.
  10. Remember technique. If you practice with bad technique, you’ll engrain that into your brain, and bad technique can lead in injury.

There are plenty of additional ways to protect yourself, also. Boxing injury-free is the aim for any quality program.

Come by FightersNashville to find out how our gym is dedicated to helping you maximize success, whether you box for fitness, for fun, for recreation, or for competition.

 

Founder and Director of Fighters, Dr. Christy Halbert has used her background as an academic in sociology, collegiate athlete, and professional boxer to take a multi-disciplinary approach to the sport of boxing. Halbert was a 2012 Olympic Coach for Team USA, and is a IWBHF Inductee.

item.title: 7 Reasons to Start Boxing in the New Year
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
1. Build Cardio Fitness
    Training in boxing — dynamic warmup, shadow boxing, hitting bags — is done in rounds of two or three minutes with rests of about 1 minute between rounds. This High Intensity Interval Training improves cardiovascular fitness. There’s no shape like boxing shape.
  2. Reduce Body Fat
    Combinations are explosive bursts of power, so boxers develop muscular endurance and power. Muscles have to adapt to full-body training, so the legs, core, and upper body will get stronger. Want to lean out? Dial in nutrition to speed up the process of getting in shape.
  3. Improve Mental Health
    Boxing improves mood and mindset because you have to give complete focus and concentration to training on skills, so you get a break from problems on your mind. Boxing training is also practice at taking action.
  4. Reduce Stress
    Hitting bags is a great way to rid the body of cortisol (the stress hormone). Any exercise, even walking, can reduce stress, but boxing does it faster since hitting bags hard exerts muscles.
  5. Build Confidence
    Building competence in boxing skills leads to improved confidence. Seeing progress, even though it’s sometimes slow, will help keep you motivated as you learn to punch faster and harder, and learn new skills.
  6. Improve Social Life
    Our boxing gym is diverse and full of people who simultaneously support and challenge each other. At Fighters Nashville we welcome everyone. You’ll meet new people, train alongside people similar and different than you, and make new friends as you face challenges together.
  7. Face a Challenge
    The start of a new year is a great opportunity to try new things and start new habits, which help us grow. Boxing is fun, too.

Come by Fighters Nashville to see how our gym’s system can help with these benefits, and more.

Don’t wait to get in shape. Our gym is judgement-free, and there are no critics. Our goal is simply to help you reach your goals for the new year.

item.title: Billy Falco Named Interim Head Coach of Fighters Boxing Gym
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
Billy Falco has accepted the position of interim head coach of the Fighters Boxing Club in Nashville, Tennessee.

Coach Billy has been a boxing coach at Fighters for five years, training under Olympic Coach Christy Halbert. Coach Billy recently accepted the role of interim Head Coach of the competition team.

In his new role Coach Billy will be the point person for boxer promotions onto the competition team, training of competition-pathway boxers, as well as coordinating athletes’ participation in local, regional, and national competitions.

Coach Billy will continue his personal training of fitness clients, competitive boxers, and professional boxers, as well as serve as a cutman in professional boxing.

“Billy Falco is ready for this new role. He’s well-respected by the boxers, and has experience on every level of competition from beginner to professional. I’m very excited that he accepted the position, and look forward to the transition as we move into 2025,” said Coach Christy Halbert, director of Boxing Resource Center.

Fighters is also searching for additional coaches for the competition team.
Any interested persons, regardless of experience, can reach out to Coach Billy Falco or Coach Christy Halbert.

Fighters Boxing Club is a program of Boxing Resource Center, a nonprofit organization founded in 2001 by Olympic Coach Christy Halbert. The 501.c(3) organization is dedicated to education, research, and training of youth and young adults in the science and art of Olympic-style (amateur) boxing. We teach science, not violence, and train by the values of best effort, scholarship, integrity, civility, and teamwork.

Our coaches welcome all persons, regardless of their personal goals — fitness, recreational, or competitive. We are a volunteer-led organization.

For more information, please visit our website at www.BoxingResource.com.

 

Founder and Director of Fighters, Dr. Christy Halbert has used her background as an academic in sociology, collegiate athlete, and professional boxer to take a multi-disciplinary approach to the sport of boxing. Halbert was a 2012 Olympic Coach for Team USA, and is a IWBHF Inductee.

item.title: Jake Paul vs Mike Tyson
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
a.k.a…
The YouTuber vs The Legend
“The Problem Child” vs “The Baddest Man on the Planet”
The 27-year-old vs The 58-year-old

Good for boxing?

This fight is more spectacle than real boxing, but both fighters ARE actual professional boxers. Whether it’s a good fight will depend on whether the two compete in earnest.

Having said that, a large and diverse audience will tune in, and that’s good for the sport. Jake Paul has also improved immensely in his short boxing career, and he punches hard. So this could be a competitive fight.

When you tune in, note the following fight fight rules were negotiated:

  • Scheduled for eight rounds
  • 2-minute rounds

  • Boxers will wear 14oz gloves

Who wins?

At 6’1″, Paul has a sizeable physical advantage over the 5’10” Tyson.
The age gap of 31 years is real, but so is the experience gap. The fight was originally set for July before Tyson had to postpone due to a medical issue. Tyson has a professional record of 50-6 (44KOs). However, Tyson last entered the ring in 2020 for an exhibition fight with Roy Jones, Jr, and Tyson’s last actual pro fight was way back in 2005.
Paul is only 11-1 (7KOs) as a professional, but you can’t underestimate his reach, confidence, and energy.

The current Jake Paul vs Mike Tyson odds list Paul as a -275 favorite, and Tyson as a +210 underdog.

Roy Jones Jr. believes Tyson will win, maybe by KO.
Shannon Briggs, who previously trained Jake Paul and his brother, predicts a KO for Tyson.
Lennox Lewis, who defeated Tyson by knockout in the 8th round of their heavyweight clash in 2002, thinks Tyson wins.

Regardless of who gets their hand raised at the end of the fight, they both win very large purses — Tyson’s predicted to make at least $20 million, and Paul will make around $40 million.

Fight of the Night? Don’t miss the co-main event!

The better fight is expected to be Katie Taylor vs. Amanda Serrano will be for the undisputed super lightweight championship held by Taylor (WBA, WBC, IBF, WBO, and The Ring lightweight title bout). Their fight is a re-match. The first Taylor v Serrano was in New York on April 30, 2022 in Madison Square Garden, and was fast-paced, aggressive, and featured some big punching. Taylor won a split decision.

The bout will be contested over 10 two-minute rounds.

ESPN has Taylor ranked No. 2 and Serrano at No. 3 on its women’s boxing pound-for-pound list.

Taylor made her professional debut in November 2016 following a decorated amateur career highlighted by a gold medal at the 2012 Olympic Games. Within a year, Taylor became a world champion, and claimed all four titles to become the undisputed lightweight champion. Katie Taylor is 37 years old, and is a hero in her home country of Ireland. Taylor is promoted by Eddie Hearn’s Matchroom Promotions.

Serrano moves up three weight classes for this fight.
Serrano’s had a longer career, and is a seven-weight world champion (the second-most of any boxer in history — the only fighter to win more is Manny Pacquiao). Amanda Serrano is 35 years old, and is from Puerto Rico, has won four in a row since losing to Taylor. She had to withdraw at the 11th hour from her last scheduled bout in December.

Serrano fights under Jake Paul’s promotional company, MVP. She has announced that this will be the last time she’ll fight two-minute rounds. She feels so strongly about women fighting the same standard round-length as men, that she relinquished her WBC featherweight title because WBC does not allow women to box three-minute rounds. Serrano is making an exception for Taylor because “I’m coming for her belts. [Taylor] wants 10×2, so that’s what we will do.”

The card is free on Netflix! If you want to watch in the company of other fans of the sweet science, come to the gym.

At Fighters Boxing Gym, we are an authentic boxing gym. We aren’t fancy, we’re real. We are a community of boxers and coaches who support each other. Come by Fighters Nashville to discuss your goals with an authentic boxing coach who’s trained to help.

item.title: 5 Critical Ways to Protect Your Hands
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
Boxing training has so many benefits, however we need to take care of our hands.

  1. Wrap hands with care — focus on protecting the knuckles, wrist, and thumb. Take your time to wrap well. Wash your wraps regularly to prevent bacteria forming in your gloves.
  2. Use proper gloves. Gloves should have adequate padding on the knuckles, and fit your hand well. A snug glove will be most comfortable. Consider the design — your finger tips shouldn’t be cramped, and your thumb shouldn’t feel like it’s in a bind. Dry your gloves after use to prevent bacteria forming in the gloves.
  3. Strike targets with your wrist and elbow behind the fist. Make contact straight, not hyperextended. Keep your hand closed when making contact.
  4. Build your tolerance for impact. Condition your hands for impact gradually. Don’t show up on the first day and hit targets as hard as you can.
  5. If it hurts, stop, especially if it’s a sharp pain. There are plenty of things to do in the gym if you have hand pain. For example, you can shadow box. If you experience a “bad” or “worrisome” pain, stop. Better to take a little caution than to cause a full injury because you weren’t listening to your body.

Take care of your hands, and your hands will take care of you!

Want to learn boxing, get a non-contact boxing workout, or learn to spar or compete? Fighters Nashville has experienced and certified coaches that teach real boxing skills, tactics, and strategies.

Come by the gym to discuss your goals with an authentic boxing coach who’s trained to help.

Founder and Director of Fighters, Dr. Christy Halbert has used her background as an academic in sociology, collegiate athlete, and professional boxer to take a multi-disciplinary approach to the sport of boxing. Halbert was a 2012 Olympic Coach for Team USA, and is a IWBHF Inductee.

item.title: Make Non-Contact Boxing More Fun
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
Boxing training is one of the best ways to get a great workout while having fun. At Fighters Boxing Gym, we teach real boxing skills as you burn calories and get fit. Fitness boxers, aka non-contact boxers, just need to remember a few important things to maximize the workout while maximizing fun.

  1. Immerse yourself. Take the opportunity to leave your troubles behind for an hour. Enjoy a reprieve from the stressors of your day.
  2. Try new things. A new combo. A new piece of equipment. Expand your toolbox and access something new to keep boxing fun.
  3. Switch stances. Right-handed? Try a few rounds in the southpaw stance. You can speed up skill-building by training about 5%-50% of any given workout in the opposite stance.
  4. Protect your hands. Use proper hand wraps and gloves. Punch correctly. Gradually increase impact. Take care of your hands so they can take care of you.
  5. Ask questions. Our coaches are in the gym to help you, but none of us are mind-readers. We love to talk boxing. Tell us your goal(s) so our coaches can get you going in the right direction.

Come by Fighters Nashville to discuss your goals with an authentic boxing coach who’s trained to help.

Founder and Director of Fighters, Dr. Christy Halbert has used her background as an academic in sociology, collegiate athlete, and professional boxer to take a multi-disciplinary approach to the sport of boxing. Halbert was a 2012 Olympic Coach for Team USA, and is a IWBHF Inductee.

item.title: 5 Steps to Start Boxing at Any Age
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
1. Start training today.
    Come to the gym now. You don’t need to be in good shape. You don’t need to already know boxing. Our coaches will work with you no matter where you’re starting.
  2. Be honest with coaches.
    Tell coaches your goal. We’ve been coaching a long time, so we’ve worked with people who want to just have fun, or want to have fun, or want to learn to spar, or want to have just one match, or want to compete as an amateur, or want to have a career as a professional, or want to go for a the Olympic Games. And it’s also okay if your goal changes…just be honest with us so we can best help you.
  3. Get in the right mindset.
    Boxing isn’t easy. Be ready to be challenged mentally and physically. Be ready to sometimes feel like you aren’t making progress very quickly. And also be ready to see the gains as you put in the work. Maintain a growth mindset — be positive and be open to learning new things in new ways.
  4. Apply yourself.
    Ask questions — our coaches are there to help you. Attend classes. Use our open gym hours to apply what you’re learning. Stay hydrated. Dial in your nutrition. And remember to have fun in the process of reaching your goal in the sport.
  5. Grab some gear.
    You can borrow gear at our gym, until time for you to have your own equipment. Based on your goal, coaches will advise you on the equipment you need. Some can be purchased at the gym, or coaches will tell you about online options. Boxing doesn’t require a lot of personal gear, but take safety seriously. Quality hand wraps and quality gloves will make a big difference. And if you spar, you’ll need a form-fitted mouthguard, headguard, groin protector (mandatory for men), and appropriate shoes.

At what age is it too late to become an amateur boxer? It’s never too late to pursue your dream.

Founder and Director of Fighters, Dr. Christy Halbert has used her background as an academic in sociology, collegiate athlete, and professional boxer to take a multi-disciplinary approach to the sport of boxing. Halbert was a 2012 Olympic Coach for Team USA, and is a IWBHF Inductee.

item.title: Boxing & Football: 3 Ways they’re Similar
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
Boxing’s long been considered the toughest of all sports, but it has a lot in common with football (high school, college, pro, and around here we’re watching the SEC!). This fall, as you watch football games, consider a few of the ways that boxing and football overlap. If you play football, there are many ways that boxing training can be beneficial to developing some of the skills needed for football when you aren’t getting your reps on the field.

  1. Face to face with your opponent. It takes a high degree of nerve to square up and take on your opponent directly. At Fighters Nashville, we prepare you to meet challenges by giving you skills and tactics as you face opponent’s head-on.
  2. Footwork focused. Feet get you into a position to score, and help you evade opponents. The way we teach footwork at Fighters Nashville is all about the skills that are fundamental to boxing success, such as lateral, forward, backward, movement as well as using posture strategically to gain an edge when confronting an opponent one-on-one.
  3. Fast hands. Everyone at Fighters Nashville knows that speed can be improved. On the gridiron, offense linemen need fast hands as much as boxers do. Speed makes scoring possible, especially when you can beat your opponent to the punch.

Coaches at our gym have experience cross-training football players (college and professional) in-season and off-season. Whether you want to cross-train for football skills, or want to train to improve your boxing skill, Fighters Nashville is designed around developing the specific skills, tactics, and strategies that contribute to success on the gridiron and in the ring.

Come by the gym to discuss your goals with a certified boxing coach with the track record to help.

item.title: 8 Nasty Career Traps to Avoid for Pro Boxers
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
Professional boxers have a short window in which to make their career happen. Pro boxers have to build their experience and skill, and also navigate a career in a difficult entertainment industry.

Here are 8 nasty traps to avoid:
  1. Staying with a bad trainer because it’s easy. Instead, seek out a trainer that treats you with respect, demonstrates their knowledge and interest in continuing to learn, and who supports your goals (not theirs).
  2. Trying to recreate another fighter’s path. Instead, play to your strengths that make you appealing to promoters, and find ways to win big in front of crowds.
  3. Relying on others to help you. Instead, take action yourself. You are responsible for your career. Participate in decision-making.
  4. Trusting that others in the industry have your best interests in mind. Instead, keep your head on a swivel. Build a team of trusted people around you — trainers, manager, promoter, and sparring partners — that give you energy, not worry or demotivate you.
  5. Getting caught up in minutia. Instead, focus on the big picture and don’t sweat the small stuff.
  6. Getting discouraged from a loss. Instead, decide if you want to continue. If you do, work for it. Hard work beats talent when talent doesn’t work hard.
  7. Being cocky. Instead, practice some gratitude and humility as you rise to the top. Be confident and calm. Only people who are scared and insecure are cruel to other people. Treat people well as you rise, and they’ll be there for you if and when you have a fall.
  8. Assuming your talent will speak for itself. You will not be discovered walking down the street. Instead, gain followers on social media. Network with trainers, managers, and promoters to see what opportunities lay ahead. Pro boxing is an entertainment industry.

Work to avoid these traps for a more robust and long career as a professional boxer.

Looking to fight, or want to train like a fighter? Coaches at Fighters Boxing Gym are trained to help! Pop in the gym and chat us up.

Founder and Director of Fighters, Dr. Christy Halbert has used her background as an academic in sociology, collegiate athlete, and professional boxer to take a multi-disciplinary approach to the sport of boxing. Halbert was a 2012 Olympic Coach for Team USA, and is a IWBHF Inductee.

item.title: Mindset Matters
item.dc:creator: ben@growth-factor.ai
item.content:encoded:
It’s true that your mindset can take you to a higher level in boxing, just like in every aspect of your life.

You don’t need to be a psychologist to focus on mindset. In fact, making a few changes on your own can unlock the benefits of how proper mindset can make all the difference in training, competition, and enjoying the process of improvement.

  1. Positive Attitude — Being positive in practice and competition keeps you open to new ideas/combos/tactics, allows your brain to absorb more information, and propels you through adversity. Confidence also emerges from a positive mental mindset.
  2. Train to Win — Don’t fight to survive. Fight to win. This shift in mindset is difference between doing and winning convincingly. Commit to give your all, whether that’s a training session or a competitive match.
  3. Improve competence — Put the work in. Building skill is the secret to feeling more competent. Feeling more competent leads to greater effort in training, which then leads to more competence in skill.
  4. Trust your Training — If you have a supportive team in place, with coaches that are positive and realistic, and you’ve been putting in the work, you can go into any situation — a tough training session, a spar, or competition, knowing that you are well-prepared.

Founder and Director of Fighters, Dr. Christy Halbert has used her background as an academic in sociology, collegiate athlete, and professional boxer to take a multi-disciplinary approach to the sport of boxing. Halbert was a 2012 Olympic Coach for Team USA, and is a IWBHF Inductee.
